title: Fixed-degree vanishing for a closed projective subscheme
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative ring, i:X -> P^N_A a closed immersion, F a quasi-coherent finitely presented module on X, and q>0. There exists t0 such that H^q(X,F tensor i^*O(t)) is zero for all t>=t0.

source.place: Tag 01YS (4), whose induction proof is the fixed-degree part of Tag 0B5T (4)

proof.text: Establish simultaneously for all closed immersions and coherent modules the eventual vanishing predicate P(r). For r>N use the cohomology-bound theorem with threshold zero. Descend from N+1 to the specified positive q using the induction-step theorem and Nat.decreasingInduction'. If q>N use the bound directly. Finally specialize P(q) to i and F.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01YS (4), base case and finite descending induction made explicit by J4

theorem exists_isZero_closedImmersion_twist_degree
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {X : Scheme.{u}} {N : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin (N + 1)); Spec (.of A))) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation] (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ∃ t₀ : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, t₀ ≤ t →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj
        (tensorObj F (ProjectiveSpace.twistRestrict i t)))
